signature.name: VTask.pi

conventions.statement: The source of `VTask.pi ei` is `Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => (ei i).source)`: a dependent function lies in the source iff every component lies in the source of the corresponding component equivalence.
conventions.note: Pointwise source condition over all indices.

conventions.statement: The target of `VTask.pi ei` is `Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => (ei i).target)`: a dependent function lies in the target iff every component lies in the target of the corresponding component equivalence.
conventions.note: Pointwise target condition over all indices.
